meta.title: High Voltage — Commercial & Industrial Energy
meta.description: Cost, risk and return, not just supply. Hubble designs the energy a business needs to do its job, then connects, manages and supports it so it keeps delivering.

hero._beats: One beat is all the comp draws. The machinery takes any number — add an entry with its `frame` index (0-258) and the copy scrubs to it, the way the landing page runs three across 422 frames. `eyebrow` is empty on purpose: this comp puts the section label in `hero.labels` above, not over the heading, and a second copy of it there was the first thing that looked wrong.
